subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): guard assertHttpUrlTargetsPrivateNetwork against malformed URLs

question: Should the shipped Plugin SDK helper preserve Node-compatible `TypeError` and `ERR_INVALID_URL` semantics while removing sensitive `input`, or intentionally adopt a new plain-`Error` contract?
rationale: Both shapes can prevent credential disclosure, but choosing the permanent public SDK error contract requires maintainer compatibility intent.

options.title: Preserve Error Semantics
options.body: Emit a sanitized `TypeError` with `ERR_INVALID_URL` and no `input` or `cause`, minimizing third-party upgrade risk.

options.title: Adopt Plain Error
options.body: Approve the new plain `Error("Invalid URL")` contract and accept that existing error-class or code checks may stop matching.

recommendation.title: Preserve Error Semantics
recommendation.body: Emit a sanitized `TypeError` with `ERR_INVALID_URL` and no `input` or `cause`, minimizing third-party upgrade risk.
